speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

beats.text: This is a terminal with agents in it. A dev server, a system monitor, and Claude — every cell is a real pty.
The agents are the ones that ask questions. Amber means one needs you — and only amber chimes. Answer it, and everything keeps moving.
